edits.text: Data engineer with over 8 years of experience in media and art, building Python → BigQuery pipelines on GCP, dbt transformation layers with tested metric definitions, and the data products on top of them, including a RAG assistant with an evaluation layer. Pipeline automation improved data-operation efficiency by 100%. Trilingual (English, Japanese, Mandarin) with a Master's in Economics.
Data Pipelines: Built Python ingestion of daily multi-platform video metrics into BigQuery, scheduled on Cloud Run, improving data-operation efficiency by 100%.

dbt Transformation Layer: Built dbt models for newsroom social performance across 4 platforms (staging → intermediate → marts) with metric definitions, data tests, and a reconciliation script against 13 legacy views to keep Looker Studio dashboards working.
AI Data Products: Built an internal RAG assistant (BigQuery → Vertex AI Search → Gemini) with a Cloud Run sync job and deterministic evaluation checks, accelerating retrieval speed by 30%.
Data Engineering: BigQuery, dbt, Cloud Run, Prefect, MySQL, MongoDB.
